notes: Totals match the 105-piece parts list. The minifigure parts (head, torso, legs, helmet, orange armour, trans-green stud) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.
Several rests_on lists are best guesses. The booklet art is low-resolution, and in some steps (body steps 4-6, the head brackets, the paw layers) I could not tell which pieces sit on which.

Body: the dark towball plates are shown as sitting on the 2x6 plate. The 4 side balls (b7, b8, b11, b12) are assigned as: b11 and b12 take the rear legs A and B, b7 and b8 take the front legs C and D, and b15 on top of the front pair takes the head.

Part-number mapping: 2540 is the white side-handle plate (body step 5, head step 2). 4081b is the white clip plate in head step 6. 50950 is the curved 3x1 in the front-leg step 6, and 85984 is the pair of ear slopes. 11477 is used twice in the rear legs and twice on the head cheeks.

Leg A is the rear-right leg (booklet step 9), leg B is the rear-left (step 10), leg C is the front-near leg (step 11) and leg D is the front-far leg (step 12). The four paws (step 13, 4x) are each joined to a leg by ball and socket.
The booklet shows two tooth plates (49668) per front leg. I put one on top of the 14704 and one under it, clutching its underside, so the lower one has an empty rests_on and an other_join.

Connectivity fix: the build was split into four groups, which the booklet does not mean. The beast, the sword with its hand piece, the shield and the loose card were not linked. The minifigure rides on the beast's back (page 31) but is not in the parts list, so its pieces are not recorded. I let the pearl-gold hand piece (b102) stand in for the minifigure and rest on a body plate (b9). The sword and shield are joined to that hand piece.

The sticker sheet is joined to the head print piece as a representative join, since the stickers go on the head, legs and paws. The trading card is a loose paper item. I linked it to the sticker sheet by a non-fastened contact only so it is not an orphan; it is not really built into the model.
